faq_heading: Burnaby houses with suites: your questions answered

faq.q: How much does a Burnaby house with a suite cost?
faq.a: The 48 houses with a legal suite that closed between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026 had a median of $2,625,000, with the middle half between $2,115,200 and $3,062,500. Every Burnaby detached house had a median of $1,850,000.

faq.q: What is the difference between a legal and an unauthorized suite in Burnaby?
faq.a: A legal suite is listed as Legal Suite or Licensed Suite, and an unauthorized one as Unauthorized Suite. 48 Burnaby houses sold with a legal suite and 134 with an unauthorized one, which had a median of $1,824,000.

faq.q: Does a suite count toward the number of units on a Burnaby lot?
faq.a: Yes. Under the R1 district a secondary suite counts toward the lot’s unit total, and each primary unit may have one.

faq.q: What does renting a suite add to a Burnaby utility bill?
faq.a: In 2026 it adds $326.17 for water and $403.00 for sewer, on top of the $652.33 water charge for a detached house.

faq.q: Which Burnaby neighbourhoods have the most houses with legal suites?
faq.a: East Burnaby had 7 legal-suite sales, South Slope 6 and Burnaby Lake 4 between November 1, 2025 and August 31, 2026.

faq.q: How fast do Burnaby houses with a legal suite sell?
faq.a: 34 days at a median, closing at 94.7% of list, with 0% over the list price.

This search lists detached houses for sale in Burnaby North, Burnaby South and Burnaby East that have a suite, legal or marked unauthorized. The busiest areas by house sales were South Slope (38), Capitol Hill (28), East Burnaby (27), Parkcrest (23) and Vancouver Heights (19). Condos, townhomes and half duplexes are separate searches.

Of 411 detached houses that closed in Burnaby between November 1 and August 31, 182 (44%) had a suite: 48 legal and 134 unauthorized. The legal-suite houses sold for a median of $2,625,000, 42% more than the $1,850,000 median for every Burnaby house.

It has 3,994 square feet of floor area, against 2,715. 96% of legal-suite houses have two or more kitchens, compared with 58% of all houses. Unauthorized-suite houses were smaller at 2,720 square feet and a median $1,824,000.

Alongside suites, 133 Burnaby houses had lane access, at a median of $1,780,000; 7 were marked as a coach or laneway house at $3,165,000; 3 had a second residence on the lot. These are separate flags in the same Paragon records, and a house can carry more than one.

blocks.text: Burnaby suite rules

Burnaby moved almost every house lot into its R1 Small-Scale Multi-Unit Housing District on July 1, 2024. A lot of 280 square metres (3,014 square feet) or less can take 3 units, a larger one 4, and 5 to 6 units only in a Frequent Transit Neighbourhood Area.

Each primary unit gets one secondary suite, the suite counts toward the lot’s unit total, and it stays on the same title as the house. The new Zoning Bylaw 2026 was adopted June 9, 2026 and took effect July 1, 2026.

Slopes and creeks shape Burnaby building. A lot beside a creek falls under the Streamside Protection and Enhancement Development Permit Area, and the City’s checklist effective August 1, 2026 asks for a geotechnical report on sloped sites, so ask what engineering stands behind a suite on a hillside.

The MLS® Home Price Index benchmark for a detached house in Burnaby North was $1,808,500 in September 2026, 9.2% down over twelve months. In Burnaby South it was $1,894,600. The benchmark is the price of a typical house, not a median of sales.
Costs of a Burnaby house with a suite

For 2026 Burnaby charges $1.72223 per $1,000 of assessed value, with a Metro Vancouver rate of $0.05440 added. A detached house pays $652.33 for water and $159 for the default garbage toter. Renting out a suite adds $326.17 for water and $403.00 for sewer. The city is inside the Speculation and Vacancy Tax area.
Before you offer on a Burnaby house with a suite

items.t: Ask for the Burnaby permit and final inspection for the suite. 134 of the 182 suite houses sold here were unauthorized, so the paperwork comes first.
Ask whether the extra water and sewer charge for a rented suite is being billed. Burnaby adds $326.17 for water and $403.00 for sewer when a suite is rented.
Count the units. Burnaby gives each primary unit one suite and counts it toward the lot’s total of 3 or 4, so check how many units the lot already carries.
If a tenant lives in the suite, ask for the tenancy agreement and the rent; a tenancy usually carries on after a sale. Legal-suite houses took 34 days to sell, so there is time to ask.

If the listing says unauthorized, compare the price with the $1,824,000 median for unauthorized-suite houses and the $2,625,000 median for legal ones, then decide whether to legalize the suite or remove it.
